title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Dashboard adoption page adds an All licence view
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap, licence thresholds and PowerShell parameters support its central guidance. Extend the admin path to the access setting, acknowledge Microsoft's conflicting administrator-role descriptions, and remove the unsupported assertion about which page readers open first.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The exclusion list can exclude any Microsoft 365 licensed user's Copilot Chat web usage from dashboard analysis.
claims.quote: The exclusion list allows admins to exclude any Microsoft 365 licensed user from being analyzed in the Copilot Dashboard for their Microsoft Copilot Chat (web) usage, which isn't associated with any Microsoft Copilot or Viva Insights license.

claims.claim: The exclusion policy must be turned on for the exclusion list to apply.
claims.quote: To use an exclusion list, you must turn on the policy.

claims.claim: The exclusion list is managed through VFAM using PowerShell or VFAM.
claims.quote: You can manage the exclusion list with Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) using PowerShell or VFAM.

claims.claim: Exclusion-list changes take up to three days to take effect.
claims.quote: After you remove users with an exclusion list, it will take up to three days for the changes to take effect.

claims.claim: Previous Copilot Dashboard-specific admin-center and PowerShell access controls are no longer available.
claims.quote: Previous controls to manage access to the dashboard using the Copilot Dashboard control in the Microsoft 365 admin center or using PowerShell are no longer available.

claims.claim: The AI Administrator or Global Administrator can enable or disable the Viva Insights web app.
claims.quote:
Enable or disable the Viva Insights web app
Applies to: AI Administrator
In addition to the roles described below, all settings can also be managed by Microsoft 365 Global Administrators.
claims.fix: Append to the control note: 'The settings page names AI Administrator (and Global Administrator), while the VFAM feature table lists Global admin for Viva Insights web app.' Both pages are already cited: https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/advanced/admin/manage-settings-copilot-dashboard and https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/feature-access-management.

claims.claim: The Viva Insights web app access control supports tenant-wide application.
claims.quote: The AI admin can turn the Viva Insights web app on or off at the tenant, group, or user level

claims.where: controls[0].governs, note; Governance controls; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Disabling the web app disables the whole app, including the Copilot Dashboard, rather than configuring the License filter.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy reaches the feature-access policy wizard.
claims.quote: select Viva from the settings menu. ... Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access. ... Select Create a policy. ... Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off to enable or disable the feature.
claims.fix: Extend controls[0].ui.path to 'Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > app > Viva Insights web app > Access setting'. Retain the note identifying the app and feature, and add 'Choose On or Off.' The printed route is correct but stops at the wizard rather than its access setting.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone disables web-app access tenant-wide.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.claim: The dashboard is intended for organisational leaders, technology decision makers and managers.
claims.quote: The Copilot Dashboard is intended for organizational leaders, technology decision makers, and managers, while the admin center report is intended for IT admins.

claims.claim: The adoption page is the page leaders and managers open first.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot Dashboard landing first leaders managers'; opened dashboard, release-note excerpts, introduction and analytics-introduction excerpts. The sources identify the landing page and intended audience, not readers' opening order.
claims.fix: Replace 'The adoption page is the one leaders and managers open first, and its totals now stand for a wider population than before:' with 'The adoption landing page now covers a wider population than before:'.

claims.claim: Microsoft publishes no separate price or meter specific to the All view at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot Dashboard All license type view pricing cost meter charge'; read dashboard licence table, release notes, cost/billing and meter search excerpts. No separate All-view price or meter found; published meters describe agent usage.

claims.claim: Learn does not specify the landing view when the Copilot Chat filter is absent.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot Dashboard All license view default landing page filter absent Copilot Chat'; read dashboard License type and default passages, settings, release-note and Agent Dashboard search excerpts. No rule for this missing-filter case found.

claims.claim: Learn does not explain how to enable Copilot Chat reporting for this filter.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot Dashboard enable Copilot Chat reporting VFAM exclusion list PowerShell FeatureId' and 'Copilot Chat reporting enable Viva policy'; read dashboard, settings, VFAM and manage-access-policies. No steps explicitly enabling this reporting condition found.

claims.claim: The exclusion-list section itself gives no exact path or command.
claims.quote: Searched: exclusion list PowerShell FeatureId; read the complete exclusion-list section and linked VFAM and manage-access-policies pages. The section describes PowerShell/VFAM and links onward, but prints no path or command.

claims.claim: The VFAM table lists Copilot Chat in Viva Insights but does not establish exactly how its control affects the filter or unlicensed-user data.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat reporting enable Viva policy; read VFAM feature table, its linked dashboard filter section, settings and PowerShell policy instructions. The feature is listed, but its specific filter/reporting effect is not stated.

claims.claim: The sources describing this All-view change do not describe a change to who can open the dashboard.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot Dashboard All license view default landing page filter absent Copilot Chat'; read roadmap description, July 1 release-note entry, dashboard access and settings. The change describes adoption filtering, not revised viewer permissions.

claims.claim: The roadmap change concerns a reporting view rather than autonomous actions on users' behalf.
claims.quote: The Copilot Dashboard adoption landing page will be updated to show a unified view of Copilot adoption across the organization.
